Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Supp_EPoS_serum_validation.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Fig6_pathway_map`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE)
.root <- if (exists("REPO_ROOT")) REPO_ROOT else {
  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "common", "setup.R")) && dirname(d) != d) d <- dirname(d)
  d
}
source(file.path(.root, "common", "setup.R"))
```

```{r prereq, include=FALSE}
load_prereq("Fig6_pathway_map")   # loads the workspace of the previous step (or runs it first)
```

```{r paths-fig, include=FALSE}
FIG_DIR <- file.path(REPO_ROOT, "Supp_EPoS_serum_validation")
SD_DIR  <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "Source_data")
```

# Supplementary: EPoS serum metabolomics, Tables S19-S20

External comparison of the discovery serum associations with the EPoS cohort (Metabolomics Workbench ST001711; Supplementary Information only).

```{r suppleme-01}
# serum limma results from the serum section (the objects were overwritten by later limma runs)
res_steatosis <- serum_limma$Steatosis; res_inflammation <- serum_limma$Inflammation; res_fibrosis <- serum_limma$Fibrosis
# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# ============================================================
required_packages <- c(
  "openxlsx",
  "limma",
  "dplyr",
  "stringr",
  "tibble"
)
for (pkg in required_packages) {

  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {

    install.packages(pkg)

  }

}
library(openxlsx)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
# ============================================================
# 2. SETTINGS
# ============================================================
FDR_OMICS <- 0.10
METABO_FILE <- file.path(project_dir, "Analyisis/ST001711_AN002786.txt")   # Metabolomics Workbench ST001711 (AN002786)
# ============================================================
# 3. BASIC HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
safe_numeric <- function(x) {

  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

}
normalise_name <- function(x) {

  x <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  )

  gsub(
    "[^A-Z0-9]",
    "",
    x
  )

}
first_existing_column <- function(
    df,
    candidates
) {

  hits <- candidates[
    candidates %in% names(df)
  ]

  if (length(hits) == 0) {

    return(NULL)

  }

  hits[1]

}

# ============================================================
# 6. EPoS MWTAB IMPORTER
# ============================================================
#
# Important:
#
# Main data block:
#
#   Samples
#   Factors
#   feature rows...
#
# SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS:
#
#   x[1] = SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS
#   x[2] = -
#   x[3] = SAMPLE ID
#   x[4] = FACTORS
#   x[5+] = CLINICAL DATA
#
# Metadata can use:
#
#   Kleiner.Steatosis:1
#   Inflammation:1
#   Kleiner.Fibrosis=1a
#   NAS=4
#
# ============================================================
read_epos_mwtab <- function(file) {

  cat(
    "\nReading:",
    file,
    "\n"
  )

  lines <- readLines(
    file,
    encoding = "UTF-8",
    warn = FALSE
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Locate data block
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  start_idx <- which(
    trimws(lines) ==
      "MS_METABOLITE_DATA_START"
  )

  end_idx <- which(
    trimws(lines) ==
      "MS_METABOLITE_DATA_END"
  )

  if (
    length(start_idx) != 1 ||
    length(end_idx) != 1 ||
    end_idx <= start_idx
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nCould not locate MS_METABOLITE_DATA_START/END in ",
      file
    )

  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Samples header
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  header <- strsplit(
    lines[start_idx + 1],
    "\t",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  if (
    length(header) < 2 ||
    trimws(header[1]) != "Samples"
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nUnexpected Samples header in ",
      file
    )

  }

  sample_ids <- trimws(
    header[-1]
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Features
  #
  # start + 1 = Samples
  # start + 2 = Factors
  # start + 3 = first feature
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  data_lines <- lines[
    (start_idx + 3):(end_idx - 1)
  ]

  data_lines <- data_lines[
    nzchar(
      trimws(data_lines)
    )
  ]

  if (
    length(data_lines) == 0
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nNo feature rows found in ",
      file
    )

  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Parse rows
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  parsed <- lapply(
    data_lines,
    function(z) {

      x <- strsplit(
        z,
        "\t",
        fixed = TRUE
      )[[1]]

      if (
        length(x) < length(header)
      ) {

        x <- c(
          x,
          rep(
            NA_character_,
            length(header) -
              length(x)
          )
        )

      }

      if (
        length(x) > length(header)
      ) {

        x <- x[
          seq_len(
            length(header)
          )
        ]

      }

      x

    }
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Feature names
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  feature_names <- vapply(
    parsed,
    function(z) {

      trimws(
        z[1]
      )

    },
    character(1)
  )

  if (
    any(
      is.na(feature_names) |
      feature_names == ""
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nMissing feature name in ",
      file
    )

  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Numeric matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  value_mat <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(parsed),
    ncol = length(sample_ids)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(parsed)) {

    value_mat[i, ] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        parsed[[i]][-1]
      )
    )

  }

  rownames(value_mat) <- make.unique(
    feature_names
  )

  colnames(value_mat) <- sample_ids

  # ==========================================================
  # SAMPLE METADATA
  # ==========================================================

  factor_idx <- which(
    grepl(
      "^SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS\\s",
      lines
    )
  )

  if (
    length(factor_idx) == 0
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nNo SUBJECT_SAMPLE_FACTORS records found in ",
      file
    )

  }

  metadata <- tibble(
    SampleID = sample_ids,
    Factors = NA_character_,
    Clinical = NA_character_
  )

  for (idx in factor_idx) {

    x <- strsplit(
      lines[idx],
      "\t",
      fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]]

    if (
      length(x) < 4
    ) {

      next

    }

    # IMPORTANT:
    # Sample ID = x[3]
    sid <- trimws(
      x[3]
    )

    if (
      is.na(sid) ||
      !sid %in% metadata$SampleID
    ) {

      next

    }

    pos <- match(
      sid,
      metadata$SampleID
    )

    metadata$Factors[pos] <-
      trimws(
        x[4]
      )

    if (
      length(x) >= 5
    ) {

      metadata$Clinical[pos] <-
        paste(
          x[5:length(x)],
          collapse = " | "
        )

    }

  }

  # ==========================================================
  # FIELD EXTRACTION
  # ==========================================================

  extract_field <- function(
    factors,
    clinical,
    key
  ) {

    txt <- paste(
      ifelse(
        is.na(factors),
        "",
        factors
      ),
      ifelse(
        is.na(clinical),
        "",
        clinical
      ),
      sep = " | "
    )

    pattern <- paste0(
      "(?:^|[|;[:space:]])",
      key,
      "\\s*[:=]\\s*",
      "([^|;[:space:]]+)"
    )

    out <- stringr::str_match(
      txt,
      pattern
    )[, 2]

    out[
      is.na(out) |
        out %in% c(
          "",
          "-",
          "NA",
          "NaN"
        )
    ] <- NA_character_

    out

  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Raw fields
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  metadata$Steatosis_raw <-
    extract_field(
      metadata$Factors,
      metadata$Clinical,
      "Kleiner\\.Steatosis"
    )

  metadata$Inflammation_raw <-
    extract_field(
      metadata$Factors,
      metadata$Clinical,
      "Inflammation"
    )

  metadata$Fibrosis_raw <-
    extract_field(
      metadata$Factors,
      metadata$Clinical,
      "Kleiner\\.Fibrosis"
    )

  metadata$NAS_raw <-
    extract_field(
      metadata$Factors,
      metadata$Clinical,
      "NAS"
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Numeric variables
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  metadata$Steatosis <-
    safe_numeric(
      metadata$Steatosis_raw
    )

  metadata$Inflammation <-
    safe_numeric(
      metadata$Inflammation_raw
    )

  metadata$NAS <-
    safe_numeric(
      metadata$NAS_raw
    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Fibrosis mapping
  #
  # 1 / 1a / 1b / 1c -> 1
  # 2 -> 2
  # 3 -> 3
  # 4 -> 4
  # 6 -> NA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  metadata$Fibrosis <-
    dplyr::case_when(

      metadata$Fibrosis_raw %in%
        c(
          "1",
          "1a",
          "1b",
          "1c"
        ) ~ 1,

      metadata$Fibrosis_raw == "2" ~
        2,

      metadata$Fibrosis_raw == "3" ~
        3,

      metadata$Fibrosis_raw == "4" ~
        4,

      TRUE ~
        NA_real_

    )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Safety checks
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    ncol(value_mat) != 627
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nExpected 627 samples in ",
      file,
      ", found ",
      ncol(value_mat)
    )

  }

  if (
    !identical(
      colnames(value_mat),
      metadata$SampleID
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nMatrix and metadata sample IDs do not match in ",
      file
    )

  }

  list(
    matrix = value_mat,
    metadata = metadata
  )

}

# ============================================================
# 10. EXTERNAL BINARY limma
# ============================================================
#
# Grade 1 vs Grades 2+3+4
#
# EPoS data are already log2-transformed and scaled.
# No extra normalization is performed.
# ============================================================
run_external_binary <- function(
    matrix_data,
    phenotype,
    fdr = 0.10
) {

  if (
    length(phenotype) !=
    ncol(matrix_data)
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nPhenotype length does not match matrix sample number."
    )

  }

  grp <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    length(phenotype)
  )

  grp[
    phenotype == 1
  ] <- "Grade1"

  grp[
    phenotype %in%
      c(
        2,
        3,
        4
      )
  ] <- "Grade2_3_4"

  keep <- !is.na(
    grp
  )

  grp <- factor(
    grp[keep],
    levels = c(
      "Grade1",
      "Grade2_3_4"
    )
  )

  x <- matrix_data[
    ,
    keep,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    any(
      table(grp) == 0
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nOne analysis group contains zero samples."
    )

  }

  design <- model.matrix(
    ~ grp
  )

  fit <- limma::lmFit(
    x,
    design
  )

  fit <- limma::eBayes(
    fit
  )

  tt <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    coef = "grpGrade2_3_4",
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "fdr",
    sort.by = "P"
  )

  tt$Feature <-
    rownames(
      tt
    )

  tt$Direction <-
    ifelse(
      tt$logFC > 0,
      "Up",
      ifelse(
        tt$logFC < 0,
        "Down",
        "Zero"
      )
    )

  tt$Significant <-
    !is.na(
      tt$adj.P.Val
    ) &
    tt$adj.P.Val <= fdr

  list(
    result = tt,
    n_grade1 =
      sum(
        grp == "Grade1"
      ),
    n_grade234 =
      sum(
        grp == "Grade2_3_4"
      )
  )

}

# 12. DISCOVERY METABOLOMICS
# ============================================================
#
# CURRENT FINAL WORKSPACE RESULTS:
#
# Steatosis      12
# Inflammation    4
# Fibrosis        0
#
# ============================================================
flatten_metabo <- function(
    x,
    phenotype,
    fdr = 0.10
) {

  x <- as.data.frame(
    x
  )

  if (
    !all(
      c(
        "logFC",
        "adj.P.Val"
      ) %in%
      names(x)
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "\nDiscovery metabolomics result does not contain ",
      "logFC and adj.P.Val."
    )

  }

  sig_idx <- which(
    !is.na(
      x$adj.P.Val
    ) &
      x$adj.P.Val <= fdr
  )

  feature <- rownames(
    x
  )

  if (
    "Feature" %in%
    names(x)
  ) {

    feature <- as.character(
      x$Feature
    )

  }

  if (
    "Metabolite" %in%
    names(x)
  ) {

    feature <- as.character(
      x$Metabolite
    )

  }

  feature <- feature[
    sig_idx
  ]

  out <- data.frame(

    Feature =
      as.character(
        feature
      ),

    Discovery_logFC =
      as.numeric(
        x$logFC[sig_idx]
      ),

    Discovery_FDR =
      as.numeric(
        x$adj.P.Val[sig_idx]
      ),

    Phenotype =
      rep(
        as.character(phenotype),
        length(sig_idx)
      ),

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE

  )

  out$Discovery_Direction <-
    ifelse(
      out$Discovery_logFC > 0,
      "Up",
      ifelse(
        out$Discovery_logFC < 0,
        "Down",
        "Zero"
      )
    )

  out$Feature_norm <-
    normalise_name(
      out$Feature
    )

  out

}

    External_feature =
      as.character(
        res_metabo_fibrosis$result$Feature
      ),

    External_logFC =
      res_metabo_fibrosis$result$logFC,

    External_FDR =
      res_metabo_fibrosis$result$adj.P.Val,

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE

  )

)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Match external statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------
metabo_feature_table <- merge(

  metabo_feature_table,

  external_metabo_results,

  by = c(
    "Phenotype",
    "External_feature"
  ),

  all.x = TRUE,

  sort = FALSE

)
metabo_feature_table$External_Direction <-
  ifelse(

    metabo_feature_table$External_logFC > 0,

    "Up",

    ifelse(

      metabo_feature_table$External_logFC < 0,

      "Down",

      NA_character_

    )

  )
metabo_feature_table$Direction_concordant <-
  ifelse(

    !metabo_feature_table$Measured_externally,

    NA,

    metabo_feature_table$Discovery_Direction ==
      metabo_feature_table$External_Direction

  )
# ============================================================
# 15. TABLE S13A
# ============================================================
make_metabo_summary <- function(
    phenotype,
    feature_table,
    external_result
) {

  z <- feature_table[
    feature_table$Phenotype ==
      phenotype,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  measured <- sum(
    z$Measured_externally,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  same <- sum(
    z$Direction_concordant %in%
      TRUE
  )

  opposite <- sum(
    z$Direction_concordant %in%
      FALSE
  )

  not_measured <- sum(
    !z$Measured_externally
  )

  data.frame(

    Phenotype =
      phenotype,

    Contrast =
      "Grade 1 vs Grades 2+3+4",

    Discovery_significant =
      nrow(z),

    External_significant =
      sum(
        external_result$result$Significant
      ),

    Measured_externally =
      measured,

    Same_direction =
      same,

    Opposite_direction =
      opposite,

    Not_measured =
      not_measured,

    Percent_concordant =
      if (
        measured > 0
      ) {

        100 *
          same /
          measured

      } else {

        NA_real_

      },

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE

  )

}
Table_S13A <- rbind(

  make_metabo_summary(
    "Steatosis",
    metabo_feature_table,
    res_metabo_steatosis
  ),

  make_metabo_summary(
    "Inflammation",
    metabo_feature_table,
    res_metabo_inflammation
  ),

  make_metabo_summary(
    "Fibrosis",
    metabo_feature_table,
    res_metabo_fibrosis
  )

)
# ============================================================
# 16. TABLE S13B
# ============================================================
Table_S13B <- metabo_feature_table[
  ,
  c(

    "Phenotype",

    "Feature",

    "External_feature",

    "Discovery_logFC",

    "Discovery_FDR",

    "Discovery_Direction",

    "External_logFC",

    "External_FDR",

    "External_Direction",

    "Measured_externally",

    "Direction_concordant"

  ),
  drop = FALSE
]
Table_S13B <- Table_S13B[
  order(
    Table_S13B$Phenotype,
    Table_S13B$Feature
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "TABLE S13A\n",
  "============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)
print(
  Table_S13A,
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

add_table("Table S20", setNames(Table_S13B, gsub("_", " ", names(Table_S13B))))
